data.title: 神罚 · 碧海清波的挂脖比基尼笑靥
data.description: 夏日碧蓝的海水轻柔拍打着白沙滩，神罚赤足涉在清澈见底的浅浪中。深蓝色的挂脖比基尼衬托出娇美动人的雪白肌肤，水珠在阳光下像碎钻般泛光。她双手撩起一捧清凉的海水向镜头泼洒，脸上洋溢着如孩童般最纯粹烂漫的笑容，落日前的海风吹拂着她银白的短发。
data.location: pristine tropical beach with turquoise waves and white sand
data.action: wading in shallow sparkling sea waves, splashing water with hands, navy halter bikini, wet silver bob hair, radiant joyful laughing expression
data.lighting: brilliant tropical sunlight glistening on splashing water drops and azure sea
data.mood: exhilarating summer joy, untainted pure bliss
data.promptProse: Wading through crystal turquoise waves on a white sand beach, Modernia wears a chic navy halter bikini. She playfully splashes water forward with a radiant, carefree laugh as the afternoon sun makes the droplets sparkle.
data.animaCaption: Modernia playfully splashing water in a navy bikini on a sunny tropical beach.
